sources.title: NLLB - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NLLB: No Language Left Behind is a multilingual translation model. It's trained on data using data mining techniques tailored for low-resource languages and supports over 200 languages. NLLB features a conditional compute architecture using a Sparsely Gated Mixture of Experts. You can find all the original NLLB checkpoints under the AI at Meta organization.
